fusions.name: Spring From Stillness
fusions.desc: Springs at a target up to 6 tiles away for 12 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Frostbreath Bark
fusions.desc: Barks out a bolt of cold that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 50% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Sun Spot Doze
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunlit Reflex
fusions.desc: By day, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
